title: Prohibition against eating blood
description: The Lord establishes a fundamental prohibition against eating blood, both for the Israelites and for the foreigners living among them. The reason is that life is in the blood, and God has given it on the altar to make atonement. Anyone who hunts a wild animal or a bird must drain its blood and cover it with earth. Whoever eats an animal that died of itself or was torn by beasts will be unclean; they must wash their clothes and bathe themselves, otherwise they will bear their guilt.
